run_orca_dataset_loader: run the python script to load the Open-Orca dataset and export the first 2000 conversations to small.json
create_orca_conversations_json: create a JSON file containing the first 2000 human conversations from the Open-Orca dataset
build_load_test_dataset: build a small JSON dataset from Open-Orca for use in load testing text-generation-inference
extract_orca_questions: extract questions from the Open-Orca dataset and format them as human conversation entries
review_main: review the main function that loads Open-Orca and writes a subset of conversations to small.json
